sloka: एतद्वचो मया तत्र मुनिना व्याहृतं पुरा ।श्रुतं हृदि च निक्षिप्तं नान्यथा तद्भविष्यति ।। ७.५१.२९ ॥
transliteration: etadvaco mayā tatra muninā vyāhṛtaṁ purā ।śrutaṁ hṛdi ca nikṣiptaṁ nānyathā tadbhaviṣyati ।। 7.51.29 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, since things have come to this pass, you should not grieve, but rather be resolute, whether for Sita's sake or for your own, O best among men.
